pages.title: Light the Fuel
pages.text: Right-click loaded Kilns and Crucible Furnaces with Flint and Steel, Fire Starter, Fire Charge, or a supported igniter. Hoppers and Bellows never ignite cold fuel. Both hands can operate an igniter.

pages.title: Costs
pages.text: Successful ignition uses one durability on damageable tools, or one nondamageable item. Creative players pay nothing. Failed/redundant ignition costs nothing. The primitive Fire Starter has one durability and is therefore single-use.

pages.title: Modded Igniters
pages.text: Items exposing NeoForge fire-starting ability work automatically. Packs can add other items to the workstation igniter tag. Charcoal Mounds use a separate charcoal igniter tag, including Fire Starter and Flint and Steel by default.

pages.title: Burnout
pages.text: Both stations consume one fuel on ignition, using its native furnace burn time. A live fire automatically consumes queued fuel when the timer expires. Fire survives recipe completion and Bellows boost expiry, even while idle. Only complete burnout requires new ignition.
